crossRefs.note: Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.

people.name: Herod
people.line: Tetrarch of Galilee during Jesus' ministry.

translations.web: Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.
translations.bsb: Neither has Herod, for he sent Him back to us. As you can see, He has done nothing deserving of death.
translations.kjv: No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.
translations.asv: no, nor yet Herod: for he sent him back unto us; and behold, nothing worthy of death hath been done by him.
